name: Pivhydrazine
summary: Pivhydrazine (trade name Tersavid), also known as pivalylbenzhydrazine and pivazide, is an irreversible and non-selective monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine family. It was formerly used as an antidepressant in the 1960s, but has since been discontinued.

pharmacology.text: Pivhydrazine (trade name Tersavid), also known as pivalylbenzhydrazine and pivazide, is an irreversible and non-selective monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine family.

uses.text: It was formerly used as an antidepressant in the 1960s, but has since been discontinued.

summaryZh: 匹戊肼（英語：Pivhydrazine）是肼家族的一種不可逆、非選擇性單胺氧化酶抑制劑。它曾在1960年代被用作抗抑鬱藥，但現已停產。
summaryZhHans: 匹戊肼（英语：Pivhydrazine）是肼家族的一种不可逆、非选择性单胺氧化酶抑制剂。它曾在1960年代被用作抗抑郁药，但现已停产。

sideEffects.en: Little is recorded about it specifically. Hydrazine MAOIs as a group can cause dizziness on standing, sleep problems and liver damage, and can trigger dangerous rises in blood pressure and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它本身的紀錄不多。肼類單胺氧化酶抑制劑整體而言可能引起起身頭暈、睡眠問題和肝損傷，也可能引發危險的血壓飆升和血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它本身的纪录不多。肼类单胺氧化酶抑制剂整体而言可能引起起身头晕、睡眠问题和肝损伤，也可能引发危险的血压飙升和血清素症候群。

fact.en: The hydrazine MAOI family began by accident in the early 1950s, when iproniazid, a tuberculosis drug, was noticed to lift patients' mood.
fact.zh: 肼類單胺氧化酶抑制劑家族起源於 1950 年代初期的一次意外：人們發現結核病藥物異丙煙肼能讓病人心情變好。
fact.zhHans: 肼类单胺氧化酶抑制剂家族起源于 1950 年代初期的一次意外：人们发现结核病药物异丙烟肼能让病人心情变好。
